No instructions were included, but assembly is simple and easy to figure out. I was able to put it together myself without issue, but it would have been faster with a second person to hold the shelves. It's really strong and sturdy and exactly what I needed to hold heavy jars of preserves. My only complaint is the sticky plastic protective film on it. It's far too sticky and a major pain to remove. Removing the film takes as long or longer than the assembly itself. Surely, they can come up with another film that does the job but lifts off more easily once assembled.

I've had this board for almost a month now and I like it very much. The coloring is vivid and consistent. The wires are so thin that bounce-outs are rare. I like the moveable ring feature (also present on the one this replaced, which we just wore out), which will extend the usable life because the heavily-hit area can be rotated periodically. Great price, as well. I think you should buy it.;)

We've had three day boards prior to this. All of which get punished, especially around that elusive nipple in the middle. This wall mounted disc has stood up to our pathetic attempts at darts performance.

I hadn't bought a dartboard for years, but my board needed changing. I researched online for dartboards online, VEVOR stood out for price. I was concerned about the quality because all other boards were more expensive. I checked reviews and all seemed favourable. I decided to take a chance. I decided on the African sisal because all research pointed to it being the best. I am very happy with my dartboard, I was pleasantly surprised by the quality. I recommend the African sisal.
It works great and was delivered fast. Good quality.
Excellent product for the price. I bought this one as a gift after I received one for myself.

The board is a decent knife wire - no staple board. The double-bull (outer) ring is a shallow inward taper - which is a little obnoxious, but it's not bad (It's getting chewed up a bit.) Overall, the board reduces wire strikes and bounce outs - and is a standard competition size. It was a drop-in swap with my Unicorn cabinet. Comes with center screw, 3 edge spacers, and a bracket (Which I did not use because of the cabinet.) Cool little addition is the white-pained Number Wire Ring. Increases visibility and speeds target acquisition for those who are less familiar with the layout. I may buy a backup for when this one gets fluffed-out. Buy it - for the price, you won't find a better board - But make sure you get the knife wire model without the staples. (They have multiple models.)
